Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii financiare
This is Worldline. 
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
 The Opportunity 
 Take part in developing business intelligence reports and building ETL pipelines eg. for SLA and KPI reporting. You will build high quality and maintainable ETL pipelines, implement the medallion architecture in our Databricks environment, work with basics CI/CD and Git for collaborative work and successful deployment across environments.
 We work in an Agile environment with iterative deliverables and clear deadlines. You will collaborate with a cross-functional, international team and partner with stakeholders to deliver timely, governance-aware insights.
 Day-to-Day Responsibilities 
Co-creating and designing data products that are robust, trustworthy for business and easy to maintain and develop
Collaborating together with our technical team, business engineers, compliance experts and product owners in building cross-functional teams with a shared vision and roadmap that enable data product agility
Deploying, monitoring, and managing pipelines and applications in production
Build Powerbi visuals, transform data and maintain data pipelines and integrations in Databricks(ETL/ELT)
Design and implement data models and datasets for reports, dashboards, and analytics
Ensure data quality, governance, and security (including GDPR compliance)
Contribute to standards and best practices for shared data platform strategy
Support stakeholders in iterative implementation within existing infrastructure
 Who Are We Looking For 
 At Worldline, we seek individuals who are visionary and capable of driving positive change. People who can step up and show what’s next. We value those who take initiative, demonstrate a passion for their work, possess a can-do attitude, and have a desire to learn and grow.
 In practice this means:
Advanced proficiency in Python (core requirement) for data manipulation, automation, scripting, and API integration
Advanced proficiency in SQ: proficient querying, data extraction, joins, aggregations;
Oracle SQL & Postgres SQL: procedural programming
Infrastructural understanding of a cloud solution and ability to establish the target architecture (Terraform, Puppet),ETL orchestration, warehousing, monitoring and alerting
Data modelling, Data architecture;
Understanding and experience of medallion architecture
Modern cloud data platforms, for example Azure, Databricks and GCP
Basic system admin knowledge of Linux, Governance, quality assurance and understanding of data regulations (PCI, GDPR)
Experience in configuring and building S3 and SFTP filetransfer solutions
Experience with managing and documenting data infrastructure—crucial for detail-focused communication/documentation
Experience with Power BI or other BI tool is a plus
 Perks & Benefits 
 At Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:
Hybrid Working Policy
Gift vouchers on the occasion of Christmas/Easter Holidays
Private medical services
21 vacation days/year
Referral bonuses for new hires recommended by you
WFH & Flexible Working Hours
Full access to the “Learning” platform
 Shape the evolution. 
 We are pushing towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers to join our journey. People with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you’ll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. And with our empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career. Wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of over 18,000 innovators across 40+ countries, and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
 Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com 
 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.
